execution_defaults.title: Workflow
execution_defaults.description: Choose which project stages run by an agent and which wait for a person. The issue assignee still selects Human, Solo, or Squad for implementation.
execution_defaults.execution_level_hint: Auto evaluates each issue. A fixed level sets the minimum planning and safety policy for new runs.
execution_defaults.build_stage_hint: Implementation runs in the issue assignee's workspace and branch.
execution_defaults.qa_stage_hint: Run project checks automatically or pause for manual testing.
execution_defaults.review_stage_hint: Ask an agent for a verdict or wait for a human code review.
execution_defaults.release_stage_hint: Production merge and release always wait for an explicit approval.
execution_defaults.advanced_hint: Progression, plan review, concurrency, and safety automation.
execution_defaults.squad_required: Bind a squad to this project before making Squad the default.
execution_defaults.model_routing_hint: Pinned preserves agent defaults. Adaptive modes use frontier planning and choose a per-step cost/quality tier.
execution_defaults.parallel_workers_hint: Requested cap; Agora bounds it to distinct agents in the generated plan
execution_defaults.review_plan_first_hint: Build and run creates a draft proposal and waits for a human to start it.

sprints.delete_dialog_description: This will delete the sprint and all its tasks. This can't be undone.
